title: 第13章 大比开始林山出手第14章 渐入佳境罗诚挑衅
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“坚叔，我不是故意的。”
林雨菲见到外面目瞪口呆的林坚，生怕对方责怪损坏家族财务，赶紧走上前去，像极了犯错的孩子。
林坚见到林雨菲突破到融血境，还施展出这么厉害的剑法，哪里还会责骂。
高兴都来不及呢！
“没事，没事，我这就去命人前来将你的房间修缮。”
林坚脸上带着笑意，赶紧说道。
“我们林家看来是要崛起了。”
林坚双眸深处弥漫着精光。
他感受的很清楚，刚才林雨菲施展出来的那一剑，就算是他这个融血境六重巅峰的存在，也不敢说能够抵挡。
刘家那个从归元剑宗回来的刘建，听说也不过是融血境三重，必然不可能是林雨菲的对手。
此番林家大比，胜负已分。
想到这里，他忍不住面露激动，转身朝着院子外面走去。
“真是奇怪，坚叔向来节俭，谁要是损坏家族财务，他可不轻饶。”
“想不到今日竟然没找我的麻烦，嘻嘻！”
林雨菲见到林坚离去的背影，忍不住嘟囔。
这些年林家灵石实在是太匮乏了，林坚掌管财政，花任何一块灵石，都小心翼翼。
咚！
“你突破到融血境二重巅峰，眼看着三家大比，你必然获得第一，为家族获得灵石矿脉接下来三年的开采权，坚叔怎么可能责怪你。”
林晨见到林雨菲调皮的模样，可爱至极，忍不住伸出手就给小丫头的脑门一个呱嘣脆。
“啊？晨哥哥，你怎么看得出来，我突破到融血境二重了？”

林雨菲闻言，瞪大眼睛看向林晨，有些错愕。
她明明已经以剑意隐匿修为。
刚才的林坚都只是感受到她突破到融血境，却并不知道她突破到二重境界呢。
“你这小丫头，在我眼中，能有啥秘密？”
林晨脸上带着淡淡笑意，故意打量了林雨菲一番。
突破到融血境的林雨菲，变得越发挺拔了不少，似乎身体都跟着长高了。
内心暗道：“你修炼剑法传承，都是我第三世的传承，你说我怎么看出来的呢？”
“晨哥哥，坏人。”
林雨菲见到林晨扫过的目光，忍不住俏脸一红，伸出手臂自然而然的挽住林晨，一副娇羞的模样。
……
“这位兄弟，我想要打听打听，你们林家府邸里面，是不是有什么人在突破呢？”
胡一水站在林家府邸外，见到那道悬浮的剑芒，朝着林家府邸降落下去，眼神之中流露出好奇，忍不住走上前，来到府邸外。
content_en:
"Uncle Jian, I didn't mean it."
When Lin Yufei saw the stunned Lin Jian outside, she was afraid that the other party would blame him for damaging the family's finances, so she hurriedly stepped forward, like a child who had made a mistake.
When Lin Jian saw Lin Yufei breaking through to the Blood Melting Realm and displaying such powerful swordsmanship, how could he scold her.
It’s too late to be happy!
"It's okay, it's okay. I'm going to order someone to come and repair your room."
Lin Jian said quickly with a smile on his face.
"It seems that our Lin family is about to rise."
Lin Jian's eyes were filled with light.
He felt very clearly that even he, who was at the peak of the sixth level of the Blood Fusion Realm, could not say that he could withstand the sword Lin Yufei used just now.
I heard that Liu Jian, the Liu family member who came back from the Guiyuan Sword Sect, was only at the third level of the Blood Fusion Realm, so he definitely couldn't be Lin Yufei's opponent.
In this Lin family competition, the winner has been decided.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but look excited, turned around and walked out of the yard.
"It's really strange. Uncle Jian has always been thrifty. He will not be lenient to anyone who damages the family's finances."
"I didn't expect you didn't cause any trouble for me today, hee hee!"
Lin Yufei couldn't help mumbling when she saw Lin Jian's leaving figure.
The Lin family's spiritual stones have been really scarce in recent years. Lin Jian is in charge of the finances and is very cautious about spending any spiritual stones.
Boom!
"You have broken through to the second level of the Blood Fusion Realm. Seeing the competition between the three families, you will definitely win the first place and obtain the mining rights of the spirit stone veins for the family for the next three years. How can Uncle Jian blame you."
When Lin Chen saw Lin Yufei's naughty look, she was so cute, he couldn't help but stretched out his hand and gave the little girl a pop on the forehead.
"Ah? Brother Chen, how can you tell that I have broken through to the second level of the Blood Fusion Realm?"
When Lin Yufei heard this, she looked at Lin Chen with wide eyes, a little surprised.
She has clearly cultivated herself with sword intent.
Lin Jian just felt that she had broken through to the blood-melting realm, but he didn't know that she had broken through to the second level.
"What secrets can you, a little girl, have in my eyes?"
Lin Chen had a faint smile on his face and deliberately looked at Lin Yufei.
Lin Yufei, who had broken through to the Blood Fusion Realm, became much taller and taller, and her body seemed to have grown taller.
He thought to himself: "The inheritance of swordsmanship you practice is the inheritance of my third life. How do you think I can tell?"
"Brother Chen, bad guy."
Seeing Lin Chen's sweeping gaze, Lin Yufei couldn't help but blush, and stretched out her arm to naturally hold Lin Chen, looking shy.
…
"Brother, I want to find out if anyone is making a breakthrough in the Lin family's mansion?"
Hu Yishui stood outside the Lin family's mansion and saw the suspended sword light descending towards the Lin family's mansion. There was curiosity in his eyes and he couldn't help but step forward and come outside the mansion.
